privacy.title: Your visitor data
privacy.intro: {{org}} keeps your visitor details for {{days}} days, then deletes them. Here you can see what it holds about you, download a copy, or ask for it to be erased.
privacy.verifyHint: We'll send a code on WhatsApp to the number you used when visiting.
privacy.nothing: {{org}} holds no visitor data for this number.
privacy.downloadHint: A ZIP file with your details, visits and photos.
privacy.eraseText: {{org}} will remove your name, number, photos and other details from every visit. Your visits remain only as anonymous counts. This can't be undone.
privacy.requestedText: {{org}} will review it and tell you on WhatsApp when it's done.
privacy.activeVisit: You have a visit in progress. Your data can be erased after you leave.
privacy.expired: For your security this page closed. Verify your number again to continue.
privacy.askContact: To see, download or erase your data, contact {{org}} at {{contact}}. They can do it for you.
privacy.askOrg: To see, download or erase your data, ask at the {{org}} reception or security desk. They can do it for you.

done.approved: Approved. The visitor has their pass.
done.waiting: The visitor has been asked to wait.
done.rejected: Declined. The visitor has been told.
